products.title: Byredo Absolu Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three elegant creations from Byredo’s collection — a warm woody floral, a soft airy musk, and a refined rose fragrance. Three miniatures that capture the modern luxury and artistic identity of the house before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Bal d’Afrique Absolu is bergamot, buchu, and African marigold over cyclamen and violet, settling into vetiver, cedarwood, and musk — radiant, warm, and sophisticated.

• Mojave Ghost Absolu is ambrette and sapodilla over magnolia and violet, settling into sandalwood, cedarwood, and musk — smooth, delicate, and effortlessly elegant.

products.title: Guerlain Homme Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three distinguished creations from Guerlain’s iconic masculine collection — a fresh woody signature, a refined almond-leather scent, and a timeless oriental classic. Three miniatures that showcase the elegance and craftsmanship of the house before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Guerlain Homme EDP is lime, mint, and rum over floral notes and green tea, settling into vetiver, cedarwood, and patchouli — fresh, smooth, and effortlessly refined.

• L’Homme Idéal Parfum is almond, spices, and bergamot over rose and incense, settling into leather, vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood — warm, elegant, and sophisticated.

• Habit Rouge Parfum is bergamot and spices over rose and vanilla, settling into leather, amber, and woody notes — classic, rich, and timeless.

Three Guerlain masterpieces, one refined set — the perfect way to discover the house’s most memorable masculine signatures.

products.title: Club de Nuit Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has five standout releases from the iconic Club de Nuit collection — a smoky fresh masculine, a rich oud signature, and refined modern fragrances. Five miniatures that showcase the character of the collection before going full bottle.

Inside:

• Club de Nuit Intense Man (CDNIM) is lemon, pineapple, and blackcurrant over birch, jasmine, and rose, settling into ambergris, musk, and vanilla — smoky, bold, and charismatic.

• Club de Nuit Oud is saffron, bergamot, and rose over patchouli, oud, and spices, settling into amber, musk, and woods — dark, luxurious, and captivating.

• Club de Nuit Bling is citrus and fruity accords over floral and spicy notes, settling into woods, amber, and musk — bright, elegant, and stylish.

• Club de Nuit Iconic is grapefruit, lemon, and mint over ginger, nutmeg, and jasmine, settling into sandalwood, incense, and woods — smooth, confident, and modern.

Five Club de Nuit icons, one exceptional set — the perfect way to discover your next signature fragrance.

products.title: Rayhaan Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has five of Rayhaan's most impressive releases — leather, woody, spicy, iris-led, and sweet gourmand personalities that offer something bold and distinctive for every taste. Five miniatures to explore before committing to a full bottle.

Inside:

  • Cordova is leather at the top over patchouli and cypress, settling into amber, woody notes, and vetiver — rich, rugged, and confidently masculine.
  • Ellwood is Italian bergamot over cypress and davana, settling into Indonesian patchouli and Virginia cedarwood — dark, resinous, and deeply sophisticated.
  • Wood Noir is cardamom and Sichuan pepper over oud, sandalwood, and vetiver, settling into tonka bean, amber, and vanilla — warm, spicy, and elegantly woody.
  • Obsidian is iris and citrus over sueded leather, settling into sandalwood, ambrette, cedar, and oud — refined, powdery, and hauntingly complex.

Five standout signatures, one exceptional set — the smartest way to discover which Rayhaan becomes your next go-to.

products.title: Swiss Arabian Heritage Discovery Set

products.title: Rayhaan New Releases Discovery Set
products.body_html:

products.title: Rayhaan Pharaoh Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pharaoh Eau de Parfum is Rayhaan's smoky, boozy take on Omanluxury Caden. Cade oil, saffron, and dark coffee over a thick vanilla-tonka base. This one needs patience. Fresh out of the box it can smell rough, but after three to four weeks of maceration the bottle transforms. Most reviewers who hated it early end up rating it an 8. Built for cold weather evenings, formal events, and date nights.

products.title: Rayhaan Terra Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Terra Eau de Parfum is the Middle Eastern house Rayhaan's take on Amouage Outlands. It shares the same resinous, spicy-oriental DNA but is tuned for easier wearing. Outlands leads with sharp frankincense that can feel confrontational. Terra pulls that back, letting a sweetened amber-maltol base and thick patchouli carry the weight. Polarizing, but less so than the original. Best for cooler evenings and formal settings.

products.title: MFK Discovery Set
products.body_html:
This set has three of Maison Francis Kurkdjian's most celebrated and sought-after releases — a warm spiced gold, an addictive floral amber, and a rich oriental evening masterpiece. Three miniatures from one of perfumery's most revered houses.

Inside:

  • Gentle Fluidity Gold is nutmeg, coriander, and juniper berry over vanilla, woody notes, and musk, settling into amberwood and musks — warm, spiced, and seductively golden.
  • Baccarat Rouge 540 EDP is saffron and jasmine over amberwood and fir resin, settling into cedar — luminous, airy, and hauntingly addictive.
  • Grand Soir EDP is benzoin at the top over amber and musk, settling into vanilla, amberwood, and benzoin — deep, warm, and breathtakingly opulent.

Three MFK icons, one essential set — the most elegant way to experience the pinnacle of French perfumery before committing to a full bottle.

products.title: Royal Opulence Discovery Set
products.body_html:

Inside:

  • Arabian Oud Amiri is tangerine, bergamot, and pink pepper over nutmeg, cedar, and patchouli, settling into amber, sandalwood, vanilla, and musk — bold, fresh, and royally commanding.
  • Ganymede (Marc-Antoine Barrois) is saffron and Italian mandarin over osmanthus, immortelle, and violet leaf, settling into mineral notes, suede, akigalawood, musk, cedar, and patchouli — metallic, salty, and uniquely unforgettable.
  • Ex Nihilo The Hedonist EDP is bergamot and ginger over akigalawood and cedar, settling into vetiver, tonka bean, and musk — crisp, clean, and effortlessly sophisticated.

Three icons of modern luxury, one opulent set — the ultimate trio for the collector who refuses to compromise.

products.title: Le Labo Hidden Gems Discovery Set
products.body_html:

Three miniatures from a house that rewards patience and curiosity.

Inside:

  • Fleur d'Oranger 27 features orange blossom, bergamot, petitgrain, lemon, and musk — pure, radiant, and luminously true to life, like standing beneath a blooming orange tree at sunrise.
  • Cedrat 37 is citron at the top over ginger, settling into musk, woody notes, and ambergris — crisp, tart, and deceptively addictive with a warm sensual depth.
  • Lys 41 features tuberose, lily, and jasmine, settling into noble woods, vanilla, and musk — opulent, creamy, and boldly floral with an unforgettable trail.

Three Le Labo gems the world hasn't discovered yet — the perfect set for those who know that the best fragrances rarely make the most noise.

products.title: JPG Men's Discovery Set

products.title: Diptyque Discovery Set

products.title: Juliette Has a Gun Discovery Set
products.body_html:

Inside:

  • Mad Madame is rose, black currant, amber, and freesia over patchouli, moss, tuberose, and jasmine, settling into castoreum, white musk, tolu balsam, and vanilla absolute — dark, sensual, and deliciously complex.
  • Not a Perfume features a single star ingredient — Cetalox — a molecule that reacts uniquely with every skin, creating an invisible, intimately personal trail that is impossible to describe but impossible to forget.
  • Ode to Dullness features star anise, cashmere wood, sandalwood, and tonka bean — soft, velvety, and quietly comforting in the most beautifully understated way.
  • Mmmm... is raspberry, geranium, and neroli over tuberose, iris, jasmine sambac, and orange blossom, settling into vanilla, caramel, sandalwood, and patchouli — fruity, floral, and irresistibly gourmand.
  • Miss Charming features Moroccan rose, litchi, strawberry, wild berries, and musk — bright, playful, and effortlessly charming.

Five distinct JHAG signatures, one perfect set — the most elegant way to discover which one is yours.

Five iconic date night scents, one stunning set — the easiest way to find your signature before the evening begins.

products.title: Floraïku Young At Heart Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Floraïku Young At Heart Eau de Parfum is the Japanese-French house's take on a floral fruity that grows up as it dries. The opening is bright citrus and watermelon. Three modern scents — for anyone who wants to smell current, not generic.

Five scents, five moods — for work, dates, nights out, and lazy weekends.

Five directions, five moods — a considered mix for anyone who wants to explore further.

Three light, lovely scents — a beautiful starting point for finding your everyday signature.

It opens with fresh, slightly spicy notes of lemon, ginger and mandarin, giving a bright start. The middle of the fragrance features soft floral notes of violet and rose, blended with warm amber. In the drydown, deep, woody notes of ambroxan, sandalwood, patchouli and oud create a creamy, long lasting scent.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Verde Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Verde Eau de Parfum is a fresh citrus aromatic fragrance for men who like clean, energetic scents. Launched in 2025, this perfume opens with bright lime and crisp green apple, giving a fresh, juicy feel. In the middle, rosemary adds a green herbal touch, keeping the scent light and lively. The base of patchouli and amber provides a warm, smooth finish that stays nicely on the skin. Hawas Verde feels modern, fresh and easy to wear for daily use.

After some time, leather, sugar cane and amber add depth and warmth. In the base, vanilla, patchouli and oud give a creamy, woody and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Obsidian Eau De Parfum is a bold and dark woody perfume for men who like strong yet smooth scents. It opens with soft iris and fresh citrus notes, giving a clean, slightly powdery start. As the scent settles, the leather note comes forward, giving a deep, masculine feel. In the drydown, warm notes of sandalwood, ambrette, cedar and oud create a creamy, woody base that feels elegant and long lasting. Rayhaan Obsidian is simple but powerful, a fragrance that suits modern men who enjoy warm, woody and leathery scents.

products.title: Rayhaan Aquatica Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Aquatica Eau de Parfum is a fresh citrus gourmand fragrance for men who like clean, sweet and tropical type scents. It opens with a bright mix of lime, coconut milk, bergamot and mandarin that feels very refreshing and slightly creamy. After a few minutes, the fragrance turns a bit sweet and floral with sugar cane, jasmine, hibiscus and gardenia, which gives it a soft tropical vibe. In the drydown, the scent becomes warm and smooth with notes of rum, musk, tonka bean and patchouli. These base notes give depth and a slightly sweet, creamy trail which stays on skin for a long time.

In the dry down, it becomes creamy and sweet with praline, blended with oak and sandalwood, making it long-lasting and addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Extrait De Parfum is a creamy, warm unisex fragrance from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It was launched in 2024 and quickly became famous for its sweet woody scent. The perfume opens with warm, spicy notes of cognac, cinnamon and nutmeg, smooth and comforting. It is sweet and fruity in the middle, with a touch of praline, plum and dates and dry, woody notes that add depth. Vanilla, tonka bean, musk and agarwood make the base creamy and warm, leaving a gentle yet distinct trail.

products.title: Riiffs Portofino Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Portofino Noir Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like a clean but strong scent. Launched in 2021 by Riiffs Perfumes, this fragrance opens with fresh, slightly sharp notes of lemon zest, green bell pepper and clary sage. The middle of the perfume slowly becomes warm and spicy with cinnamon leaf, nutmeg and neroli. In the base, creamy notes of amber, leather and dry woods give it a deep, masculine finish.
